description: This file defines and manages a list of optional bundled clusters, includes utility functions to check cluster inclusion, environment-based build decisions, and existence of release installations.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks whether a given cluster is part of the optional bundled clusters set.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines whether optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variable.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if the package JSON indicates a released bundled install via npm specification string.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides whether to build a specific cluster based on release status, environment variables, and cluster inclusion.
